verdict.rationale: Jitsu is explicitly documented as '100% open-source and can be deployed to any on-premise infrastructure,' with Helm/Kubernetes deployment guides, an operator, dev Helm chart for Minikube, and community confirmation of successfully self-hosting the open-source version. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full production self-host beyond the HN anecdote, and some community friction noted around setup complexity vs docker/helm ergonomics.
